verdict.rationale: Qodo's Agentic Toolbox (CLI/MCP) explicitly supports 'Review changes before opening a pull request' and 'Retrieve and resolve review findings' using the same engine as PR review, and it can be embedded into an 'existing coding agent' (qodo-docs-4, qodo-docs-5, qodo-docs-6). However, evidence is CLI/agent-toolbox based rather than a documented native IDE plugin (VSCode/JetBrains) surfacing review inline in the editor, so the 'same review inside my IDE' framing is only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit IDE-plugin integration docs, screenshots/UX of in-editor findings, and independent confirmation of pre-push parity with PR review quality.
